name: Shinonome Eisuke
source:
"Puppies are so cute. It's that simple."

He is a drummer who becomes as ruffled as a yakuza only when he is angry. It is widely believed that he is a former delinquent. 

Due to his profession as a lawyer, he is quick-witted and sensitive to the subtleties of people's emotions, so he is the leader of the band, but he thinks of people like toys. For some reason, he and Kyoichiro do not get along well, and they start bickering whenever they see each other.

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/live/original/character/shinonome_eisuke.html]official website[/url]]
